schema.name: Narrative Mechanics Concepts
schema.description: Canonical definitions for the major Narrative Mechanics concepts and frameworks.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Continuous Moment of Intent
hasDefinedTerm.description: A model for how decisions are shaped before explicit search, comparison, or self-aware intent.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Occlusion Bias
hasDefinedTerm.description: A model for visibility failure in which worthy products, ideas, or people never arrive at a fair comparison surface.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Constitutive Arc
hasDefinedTerm.description: A model for how repetition, mediated exposure, and field design form meaning and authority over time.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Strategic Debt
hasDefinedTerm.description: Clarity deferred early in a product or company compounds into downstream messaging and adoption problems.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Message-Market Fit
hasDefinedTerm.description: The alignment between how a product is interpreted and the conditions under which the market can recognize its value.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Narrative Drift
hasDefinedTerm.description: The erosion of strategic coherence as organizations scale, fragment, and translate themselves through multiple actors and systems.
